title: add-benchmark-lab-performance-suites-reporting-pipeline-v136
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Add v136 performance suites, profiling baselines, and reporting pipeline updates for representative workload runners. No breaking API changes.
description:
Motivation:
We need to expand the benchmark lab with an additional set of performance suites and updated profiling baselines that reflect recent workload changes (LLM multi-turn chat, mixed-batching scenarios, and long-sequence KV cache behavior). This PR adds v136 of the reporting pipeline which wires the new suites into nightly runs and updates the dashboard ingestion for improved attribution by model variant and kernel selection profile.

What this PR does:
- Adds 6 new performance suites (chat-multi-turn, streaming-heavy, embedding-bulk, mixed-latency, kv-cache-stress, long-seq-throughput).
- Adds updated profiling baselines and golden traces for the above suites (quantized and fp16 variants).
- Integrates representative workload runners for the new suites and refactors runner registration to support region-tagged runs.
- Updates the reporting pipeline to include new metrics (kernel_selection, batch_utilization, prefix_cache_hit_rate) and rehydrates the reporting schema to include model_variant tags.
- Adds CI job definitions to run smoke profiling on PRs that touch runners or reporting code.

Testing and validation:
- Local end-to-end runs against a synthetic infra staging cluster for each suite.
- Nightly pipeline validation in benchmark-lab-staging; sample dashboards were verified and spot-checked against raw traces.
- Added unit tests for runner registration and reporting schema validators.

Rollout plan:
1) Merge to main and enable PR smoke runs (this PR).
2) Enable nightly runs for v136 in benchmark-lab-staging for 48 hours and monitor regressions.
3) Promote gold baselines if no regressions observed, then enable in production nightly.

Checklist:
- [x] Add performance suites and runners
- [x] Add profiling baselines and golden traces
- [x] Update reporting pipeline and schema migrations
- [x] Add unit and integration tests
- [x] Update dashboards and alert rules (dashboard changes rolled out to staging)
